title: React UI: Account Password Feedback
businessContext: A trial account form needs immediate, understandable feedback without sending draft passwords to a service.
problemStatement: Export App. Render a controlled password input labelled Password. Four independent checks award one point each: at least 10 characters, both ASCII lowercase and uppercase letters, an ASCII digit, and a non-alphanumeric character. In [data-testid="feedback"], show Start typing for empty input, Weak for 1–9 characters with at most one passed check (also for any nonempty score 0–1), Fair for scores 2–3, and Strong for score 4. Show the numeric score in [data-testid="passed-rules"]. Recompute on every edit, including deletion.
constraints: Keep the input type=password and associate a visible label with it.
Do not store, log, or transmit the password. This meter is instructional feedback, not a password-security guarantee.

testCases.name: Empty input starts without feedback severity
Two independent checks produce fair feedback
All four checks produce strong feedback
Deleting the password resets the derived feedback

hints: Store the input string; compute the checks from it instead of maintaining a second score state.
Treat empty input separately from nonempty input with zero passed checks.
commonMistakes: Saving derived score independently and forgetting to update it on deletion.
Logging or persisting a password while debugging.
candidateTasks: Implement the default-exported App component and the documented DOM contract.
Run every interaction journey, explain edge cases, then compare your implementation with the reference.
alternativeApproaches: Extract a small pure helper for derived values; keep input state in the component. Extend with a custom hook only when behavior is reused.
